interventions.name: High-Albedo Cool Roof Coating
interventions.description: Elastomeric solar reflective coating system with high solar reflectance index (SRI > 104) applied over roof terrace.
interventions.cost_source: Maha PWD SSR 2023-24 Item 14.12 & Asian Paints SmartCare Quote
site_constraints: Terrace surface must be cured and free of active ponding water

interventions.name: Extruded Polystyrene (XPS) Over-Deck Insulation
interventions.description: 50mm high-density XPS thermal insulation board laid over RCC slab with protective polymer-modified screed layer.
site_constraints: Requires protective screed slope towards drainage outlets

interventions.name: Commercial RWH Leaf Filter & Dual First-Flush Diverter
interventions.description: Stainless steel dual-chamber first flush diversion manifold and vortex self-cleaning stainless steel mesh filter assembly.
site_constraints: Downspouts must converge to accessible ground or mezzanine utility shafts

interventions.name: 20,000 L Modular Ground Storage Tank
interventions.description: Food-grade triple-layer roto-molded polyethylene (HDPE) ground tank with interconnecting manifold, foundation PCC pad, and booster pump.
site_constraints: Requires 10 m² level ground yard or utility basement footprint

interventions.name: 40,000 L Modular Ground Storage Tank
interventions.description: 40,000 L HDPE ground storage tank array with base foundation, dual manifold, level indicator, and booster connection.
site_constraints: Requires 18 m² level ground yard or utility basement footprint

interventions.name: 60,000 L Modular Ground Storage Tank
interventions.description: 60,000 L modular storage tank array with reinforced concrete ring pad and commercial circulation manifold.
site_constraints: Requires 26 m² level ground yard or utility basement footprint

interventions.name: 80,000 L Modular Ground Storage Tank
interventions.description: 80,000 L modular commercial tank farm with heavy-duty PCC foundation and dual suction manifold.
site_constraints: Requires 35 m² level ground yard or utility basement footprint

interventions.name: 20 kWp Elevated Rooftop Solar PV
interventions.description: Grid-connected 20 kWp solar PV array on elevated steel canopy structure (min 2.5m clearance allowing roof walking and water collection).
interventions.cost_source: MNRE Rooftop Solar Benchmark / Tata Power Solar Quote 2024

interventions.name: Extensive Modular Green Roof Trays
interventions.description: 100mm substrate depth modular sedum and native succulent planter trays with root barrier and retention drainage cup layer.
site_constraints: MANDATORY: Requires licensed structural engineer certification verifying allowable live+dead terrace load exceeds 350 kg/m²
